contribution_requirements: Preserve existing files: my_model.h5, signs.py, datasettraffic/, traffic_model.ipynb, Front-end.py, Output Images/, README.md, Traffic Sign Recognition.png. New files live under src/, tests/, database/, assets/, and root-level run.py + requirements.txt.
key_patterns: 1. Model loading: 'from keras.models import load_model' with TF_ENABLE_ONEDNN_OPTS=0 env var set before import to suppress noise. 2. Prediction preprocessing: PIL Image.open() → .convert('L') → .resize((32,32)) → np.array(dtype=float32) / 255.0 → np.expand_dims(axis=-1) → np.expand_dims(axis=0) → model.predict → np.argmax(axis=-1)[0] → class lookup with key = pred+1 in signs.classes. 3. signs.py keys are 1–43 (NOT 0-indexed); model outputs 0–42; always do pred+1 when looking up. 4. Thread safety: model.predict() runs in a background threading.Thread; all widget updates dispatched via root.after(0, callback). 5. CTk pattern: ctk.set_appearance_mode('dark'); ctk.set_default_color_theme('blue'); app = ctk.CTk(); app.geometry('1280x800'); app.minsize(1024,700). 6. FigureCanvasTkAgg embeds inside a CTkFrame by passing the CTkFrame as master — works correctly in CTk 5.2.2. 7. Colors: bg=#0B1120, sidebar=#111827, card=#1E293B, accent=#38BDF8, accent2=#8B5CF6, success=#22C55E, warning=#F59E0B, error=#EF4444, text=#F8FAFC, subtext=#94A3B8. 8. History stored as JSON list in database/history.json; each record has keys: id, timestamp, filename, predicted_class, predicted_label, confidence, top3, processing_time_ms. 9. All pages inherit from CTkFrame; the App class swaps them via grid forget/grid. 10. dataset stats: 43 folders (0–42), 34776 total images, min 157, max 2010 per class.
directory_structure: c:\Users\Mahek\Traffic-Sign-Recognition\ — workspace root with existing files (my_model.h5, signs.py, Front-end.py, etc.). src/ — all new application code. src/services/ — business logic (model, prediction, image, history). src/ui/ — CustomTkinter pages. src/utils/ — logging + validators. database/ — runtime JSON history store (gitignored). assets/icons/ — no external files needed (Unicode chars used). tests/ — unittest test files.
